experiment: E7: sealed coverage (row watermark, sealed-through time, keylog), stall-proof sealing, escrow, stable-columns baseline; one real-deployment run on the default deployment (Home Assistant 2026.7.4)
registered_before: any trial of the main run (tag e7_main); only scratch-stack dry runs and a smoke run precede it
approval: PI 2026-10-08: 'Approve E7 in full' and 'Include in E7' (escrow)

parameters.LATE_BOUND_basis: about five times the largest benign late-row delay bound seen in nine earlier runs (exp/out/e7_late_delays_prior.json)
parameters.GAP_basis: reporting threshold for heartbeat gaps; does not affect detection

arms.OUTAGE_label: simulated (the run pauses its own anchor container); the adversary's own capability is the STALL arm

monitors.closure: closure scheme, encoding v2, coverage on, escrow on, per-poll cost log on (the evaluated configuration)
monitors.stable: stable-columns scheme (every stored column except states.last_reported_ts), coverage on (baseline)

outcomes.detection: per arm: trials whose target second (or, for BD, the forged row's second) the verifier flags as attributable at one-second granularity under each monitor, k of n with the exact (Clopper-Pearson) 95% interval; alongside, the earlier rule's flagged / attributable / ambiguous counts on the same run
outcomes.benign_floor: untouched one-second segments in the run window that fail, for each monitor; a segment is touched when it holds a row any trial wrote, edited or named (the paper's counting rule)
outcomes.stall: share of the closure monitor's appends accepted during each stall window; detection of the STALL edits
outcomes.outage: frozen roots anchored after the outage with their sealed_at; detection of the OUTAGE edits
outcomes.recovery: trials whose restored copy (escrow) renders the true pre-edit principal again in a throwaway hub with the same release
outcomes.cost: closure monitor per poll: copy, load, commit, append; median, p90, max
outcomes.intervals: every heartbeat gap above GAP_s and every unobservable interval, listed with its cause where known

exclusions: only trials whose harness record carries an error are excluded, and each is counted and listed; every arm is reported whatever its outcome
known_limits_stated_in_advance: backdating by less than about LATE_BOUND plus one poll period (about 35 s) is scored as a benign late row
a row changed before any poll sees it (write-time forgery) is outside the guarantee
R5 (epoch mix-up after a lost monitor state file) is open; the run does not lose the state file
